messages.content: The gallery has confirmed the Thursday review will be finished by 4:00 p.m., so I can use the Thursday evening return. Please check that flight again and look at hotels for Monday through Thursday morning. Tuesday's installation starts at 7:30 a.m., so I need a practical route to the gallery.

I’ll recheck the Delta itinerary for August 18-21 and compare three-night hotel options with current availability and taxes included. What is the gallery address, and what amount has your employer approved for the flight and hotel together?
The gallery is at 2350 Arapahoe Street. The approved amount is $1,250 for airfare and lodging. Local transportation is separate, but include the airline bag charges when you test the total.

The Delta itinerary is still available: nonstop from Atlanta Monday, August 18 at 11:05 a.m., arriving Denver at 12:25 p.m.; nonstop return Thursday, August 21 at 6:40 p.m., arriving Atlanta at 11:32 p.m. The round-trip fare remains $446 in Main Cabin. One checked bag each way would add $70 unless your card or status waives it, making the flight portion $516 for budget purposes.
Good. Is leaving the gallery at 4:00 enough time for the 6:40 flight?

It is feasible but does not leave much room for the review to run late. A weekday trip from the gallery to Denver International typically takes about 35 to 50 minutes by car, with heavier traffic capable of pushing it past an hour. Leaving at 4:00 should put you at the airport around 4:45 to 5:05, about 95 to 115 minutes before departure. Delta’s checked-bag cutoff is 45 minutes before departure, so the schedule works if you leave promptly.
Then use that return. Show me the hotel choices, and make sure the totals are for all three nights, not just nightly rates.

I found three rooms currently available for check-in Monday, August 18 and check-out Thursday, August 21. Catbird Hotel in RiNo has a standard studio at $579 before tax and $674.22 total. It is about a 7- to 10-minute car ride from the gallery early Tuesday, or roughly a 20-minute walk. Hilton Garden Inn Denver Union Station has a king room at $552 before tax and $641.37 total, about 10 to 15 minutes by car. Hyatt Place Denver/Downtown has a king room at $606 before tax and $702.48 total, usually 12 to 18 minutes by car. All three totals include mandatory hotel taxes and fees for the full stay.
Do all three actually have a room I can cancel if the installation dates move?

Yes, but the refundable rates differ from the lowest displayed rates. Catbird’s $674.22 studio can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. local time on August 17. Hilton Garden Inn’s refundable king is $679.14 total, with cancellation until 11:59 p.m. local time on August 16. Hyatt Place’s refundable king is $729.63 total, with cancellation until 11:59 p.m. local time on August 17. The earlier Hilton total I gave was prepaid and nonrefundable; the other two original totals were already refundable.
Please compare the refundable versions against the $1,250 approval, including the $70 bag allowance.

With the $446 airfare and $70 round-trip bag allowance, the combined totals are: Catbird, $1,190.22; Hilton Garden Inn, $1,195.14; Hyatt Place, $1,245.63. All three fit within the $1,250 approval. The remaining margins are $59.78, $54.86, and $4.37 respectively. Local transportation is not included, consistent with the approval terms you gave me.
Hyatt is too close to the ceiling. Between Catbird and Hilton, which is less risky for getting to the gallery by 7:30 Tuesday?

Catbird is the stronger option for Tuesday morning. It is roughly 1.2 miles from the gallery, compared with about 1.8 miles from Hilton Garden Inn, and the drive avoids more of the downtown approach. Allowing 20 minutes from the hotel lobby would provide a reasonable cushion for a 7:30 arrival. Hilton is still workable, but Catbird gives you the simpler and shorter trip.
Can Catbird hold my bag after checkout Thursday? I will not have time to return there after the review.

Catbird confirms complimentary luggage storage for registered guests on the day of checkout, subject to available storage space. You could check out Thursday morning, leave the bag with the front desk, collect it before going to the gallery, and then depart directly for the airport after the review. To avoid a return trip, you would need to take the bag with you when you leave for the gallery that afternoon.
Right, I can collect it before the review. What time is checkout, and is there any parking charge buried in that total? I will not have a car.

Checkout is at noon. The $674.22 total does not include parking, and no parking charge applies if you do not use the garage. The listed total consists of the three-night room charge, lodging tax, and the property’s mandatory destination fee. Wi-Fi and access to the hotel’s standard guest facilities are included.

All right. Book the Delta round trip with the Thursday 6:40 return and the refundable studio at Catbird. Use my traveler and payment details on file. One checked bag each way, and no optional insurance or other extras.

Before I submit both purchases: the Delta Main Cabin ticket is $446, and the checked bag charges are expected to be $35 each way at the airport rather than prepaid with this fare. Catbird is $674.22 for three nights, refundable until 6:00 p.m. Denver time on August 17. The expected combined trip amount is $1,190.22, which is $59.78 below the approved limit. Shall I complete both reservations on that basis?
Yes, complete both on that basis.

Both reservations are confirmed. Delta confirmation H7Q4LM covers the nonstop Atlanta-Denver flight on Monday, August 18 at 11:05 a.m. and the nonstop Denver-Atlanta return on Thursday, August 21 at 6:40 p.m. The ticket charged now is $446; one checked bag each way is noted, with an expected $70 total payable under Delta’s current bag pricing unless a waiver applies. Catbird confirmation CB-481730 is for one standard studio, August 18-21, at $674.22 including taxes and mandatory fees. It can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. Denver time on August 17. No insurance or optional extras were added. The expected airfare, lodging, and bag total is $1,190.22, within the $1,250 approval.
